stem: Which sentence from the selection best helps the reader visualize what Clifford looks like?

options.label: A
options.text: She told Bridwell to think of a story that would match that picture.

options.label: B
options.text: This time when he drew more pictures, he made the dog as big as a house!

options.label: C
options.text: In some countries Clifford's name isn't even Clifford.

options.label: D
options.text: Clifford's image can also be seen on everything from puzzles to backpacks and clothes.
